verdict.rationale: The Agent API offers Perplexity-hosted built-in tools for web search and URL fetch, which Perplexity runs inline before returning a synthesized, cited answer. Pro Search adds automated multi-step reasoning that runs multiple searches and fetches URL content, and the Search API returns extracted page content, so search, extract and synthesize all happen through one API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the multi-step search-fetch-synthesize flow works as documented.
